header: Every pick graded against real results. Nothing filtered, nothing hidden.

calibration.note: Buckets of shipped P x hit rate x n, computed by this grader from the graded record (no thresholds or filters in display code). 95% CIs are cluster bootstraps by player-game: rungs from the same player-game are correlated.

diagnostic.label: DIAGNOSTIC: report-only, no model change
diagnostic.clock: day 19 of the rule's clock: the trigger is evaluated once, when day 21 is graded; nothing is refit before then

minutes.source: projected minutes = the pre-tip row of data/fp_log.csv for the same player-game (logged by fantasy_points.py snapshot from the same build as the ladder snapshot, available from 2026-10-23); actual minutes = the box score the grader uses

method: Band = graded rungs with shipped P in [0.55, 0.80). Gap = mean P minus hit rate; positive means the model said more than it delivered.

Minutes error = projected minus actual minutes for the player-game; buckets are fixed a priori. Rows whose player-game has no logged minutes projection are counted in the band totals but not in the buckets.
95% CIs are cluster bootstraps by player-game (2,000 resamples, seed 20261023): rungs from the same player-game are correlated and are never treated as independent.

If the gap concentrates where minutes ran high, the cause is early-season rotations, not the probability layer. Report-only: nothing here changes the model; the only permitted live change is the pre-committed rule.

playable.label: Playable rungs only: rung >= floor(Underdog main line) + 1
playable.definition: A rung counts only if rung >= floor(main line) + 1 for that player-game-stat: the main line's over and the true alts above it. Rungs at or below the line are negative alts and are excluded. Player-game-stats with no recorded main line are excluded and counted below.
playable.source: data/main_lines.csv (main_lines.py): the Underdog board capture lines.json is built from, recorded at ladder snapshot time; 3PM history backfilled from data/ud_prices.csv; last pre-tip capture per player-game-stat wins.
playable.note: Display and reporting only. The default view (all rungs, all stats) is the record as logged; the model, the ladder log and the recalibration rule's statistics (computed on the full log) do not change.

method: Graded snapshot = the last projection logged before tip; every earlier row stays in data/ladder_log.csv, which is append-only.
Hit = actual >= rung, from the ESPN box score. Void = the player logged no minutes; counted here, excluded from hit rates.
Calibration cells with n < 30 are flagged thin. Nothing is filtered or re-run after tip; no tuning on these results, ever.

Sample sizes are shown in player-games as well as rungs: the rungs of one player-game (3PM 3+, 4+, 5+ ...) are correlated, so rung counts overstate the evidence. Every 95% CI is a cluster bootstrap by player-game.
The only permitted live change to the probability layer is the pre-committed backtests/live_recalibration_rule.md (trigger evaluated at graded day 21, validation through day 35).
Shipped P is the raw engine probability except for stats whose isotonic maps passed the 2024-25 gate (backtests/ladder_v2_rule.md); those are listed.

Playable rungs only (a display toggle, 2026-10-28): rung >= floor(Underdog main line) + 1 for that player-game-stat, from data/main_lines.csv (the board capture at snapshot time; 3PM backfilled from the pricing history). Player-games with no recorded main line are dropped from that view and counted. The default view is the full record.

first_basket.header: Every pick graded against real results. Nothing filtered, nothing hidden.
first_basket.label: Hit rate measures accuracy, not profit. Edge requires comparing to prices.
method: Ten projected starters per game logged before tip; the graded snapshot is the game's last snapshot before tip. Append-only log (data/first_basket_log.csv); row grades in data/first_basket_grades.csv.
Hit = the player scored the game's first made field goal (free throws excluded). A game without a clean label is void (shown, not hidden).

Late scratches (addendum 2026-10-22): a projected starter who did not start is a void row ('didn't start'), excluded from the hit rates, calibration and log loss; a voided top pick leaves the game without a top-pick observation. A first scorer outside the projected ten, or one who did not start, grades the game with every surviving row a miss and the game flagged with his name. Surviving rows are never renormalized.
Calibration cells with n < 30 are flagged thin. No tuning on these results, ever; constants frozen from the gate's 2024-25 fit (backtests/first_basket_v2_rule.md).

Shipped 2026-10-21 by CEO override after the locked gate FAILED (docs/data/first_basket_gate.json, Backtest page). Constants are the gate's published 2024-25 fit, unchanged; the gate verdict is unchanged.

model_median_lines.note: graded against the model's own median for calibration only; never count toward the 200

pit.note: PIT = CDF(actual FP) from the logged percentiles; a calibrated distribution puts 10% of player-games in every decile

method: FP = PTS + 1.2 REB + 1.5 AST + 3 STL + 3 BLK - TOV (Underdog). Graded snapshot = the last FP distribution logged before tip (data/fp_log.csv, append-only).
Underdog FP lines are graded from data/fp_prices.csv (last pre-tip capture per line and side); a push is void. The verdict at 200 graded lines is calibration by decile, not hit rate.

Amendment 2026-10-25: PrizePicks standard Fantasy Score lines (data/pp_prices.csv, last pre-tip capture per player and game, both sides) are graded through the same code path against the same box-score FP, tagged source = PP. The 200-line counter and the decile verdict apply to UD + PP combined; UD-only and PP-only tables are shown alongside. PrizePicks scoring is identical to Underdog's.

A player with no box-score minutes, or absent from a box score that exists, is void (shown, excluded; fp v2 rule 2d, 2026-10-27). No tuning on these results, ever (backtests/fantasy_points_v1_rule.md).

secondary_low_block.note: Secondary, pre-registered before any A1 grade was viewed: renders at its own n independently of the primary's 800; it cannot by itself convert a primary FAIL to PASS.

pit.note: raw v2 distribution PIT, diagnostic only (rule 5)

method: FP v2 = v1's joint sim with rule 2a (minutes sd x factor, short-night mixture) and 2b (rates blended toward the current season, w = GP/(GP+10)); P(over) through a frozen isotonic map fitted on the v2 replay of the graded v1 lines (2c).
One row per line: (player, game, source, line), the last pre-tip capture, over side graded; a push is void; the grader asserts uniqueness and fails loudly.
Rule 2d: a logged player-game with 0 minutes, or absent from a box score that exists, is void and leaves the pending set.

Calibration verdict at 800 combined lines (weighted |gap| <= 0.05, no decile > 0.10) on calibrated P(over), with a no-verdict checkpoint table at 200 (Amendment 1, 2026-10-28); UD / PP splits displayed. Market test at 800 lines: paired log loss vs the book (UD no-vig, PP 0.5), player-game cluster bootstrap CI must exclude 0 in v2's favour.

Amendment 1 (2026-10-28): isotonic blocks with n < 20 merged into the nearest neighbour (pooled hit rate), calibrated P(over) clipped to [0.05, 0.95]; a captured line is priced only from a v2 row logged at or before the capture. Rows logged or priced before the refit are marked pre-A1 and excluded; the gate restarted with the first slate priced by the refit map.

Amendment 2 (2026-10-28): a pre-registered secondary market test on the frozen map's low block (raw P(over) 0.1025-0.4190 -> 0.396), same paired test and baselines, its own n = 1,059 (rule 5 formula with the low-block sd 0.2080, cluster-adjusted); secondary only, it cannot convert a primary FAIL to PASS.
Paper study until both verdicts render. No tuning on these results, ever.
